title: Chapter 421
text:
The group returned to the spaceship. Sylvia was obviously still not used to her new identity and was a little reserved. Han Xiao got the three Volga brothers to teach her the basics while he was pulled aside by Herlous.

"You let her join our team?" Herlous asked with surprise.

Han Xiao briefly explained the process, glanced at him, and said, "You have a problem with that again?"

"No, I have no prejudice against a little girl, but she has no combat ability. How can she be a mercenary?"

"She has talent. With some training, she won't be worse than you."

Herlous' mouth twitched. "Comparing a little girl to me, I feel like you're insulting me."

"Hehe, you're thinking too much. I'll only insult you during sparring."

Han Xiao laughed and turned to look at Sylvia. She was surrounded by players and did not know what to do. This was Black Star's traditional welcoming ceremony.

In his previous life, Sylvia had gone through many organizations before she finally obtained Super knowledge and showed her potential. Now that she had joined his faction, if he wanted her to be useful, Han Xiao naturally had to teach her Super knowledge. According to Sylvia's path in her previous life, the most suitable path for her was the Mechanic class. Han Xiao stroked his chin and decided to train her personally.

…

Floating Dragon Island was also in the Rain Star System. Han Xiao set up the spaceship's autopilot, left the New Phylen Alliance, arrived at Floating Dragon, and handed over the resources.

Although Dekker was coerced, he had participated in the assassination. Tyrell was furious when he found out and fired Dekker on the spot. Even if there was a reason for it, he did not want to use someone who harmed the interests of the organization. After that, Tyrell apologized sincerely. Han Xiao would never let go of an opportunity to take advantage of him. This time, he asked for a higher discount as compensation, and Tyrell agreed immediately. He was different from the tour group that Rainbow Conch belonged to. He had a very close business relationship with Floating Dragon, so it was easier to talk to him.

Speaking of the tour group, a group of lizardmen came to Floating Dragon Island to receive the spaceship. At the dock, the tour group had already arrived. After transferring the compensation to Han Xiao's account, they took back the Rainbow Conch. After all the goods were unloaded, Han Xiao watched as these people left in the spaceship. He shook his head, took out his galactic communicator, and prepared to call a ship.

This time, Floating Dragon Island's Guard Captain Wilsander walked over and joked, "I heard you were assassinated?"

"It's just a child's play." Han Xiao glanced at him. "Are you interested?"

"Of course. I have to stay on this island every day to maintain law and order. Do you think my life is very interesting?" Wilsander said in annoyance.

After chatting for a while, Han Xiao sent Wilsander away and went to the side. He opened the forums and followed the competition. After the episode with Sylvia, the Pro League was finally over. Countless people were discussing it on the forums, and he roughly watched the competition.

In the semi-finals, Dynasty defeated Hydra three to two and advanced to the finals. On the other side, Tulip defeated Devil. In the finals, Dynasty and Tulip were opponents, and the viewership of the finals was through the roof. Han Xiao did not watch the recording, but looking at the content of the discussion posts, it seemed that the battle was very exciting. It was very lively, and they fought at the peak level of professional players, which opened the eyes of the players.

In the end, it was a pity that Dynasty made a small mistake when the score was 2: 2. However, Tulip seized the opportunity and snowballed into victory, causing them to lose the match. Tulip was terrifyingly stable. When facing them, any small mistake would become the key to turning the situation around.

As the results of the finals were decided, the first season of the Pro League ended in front of everyone's eyes. Tulip was the champion, Dynasty was the runner-up, and the semi-finalists were Devil and Hydra. In the Singles competition, the champion was a German player. His precise German craftsmanship was terrifying, and King Admiral was in the top four. Among all the Chinese players, King Admiral's results in the Pro League were the most dazzling, reaching the international level. As the top player in China for many years, such a result undoubtedly strengthened his position.

On the forums, the viewers of the various countries were commenting on their own teams. Although it was a pity that Dynasty did not win the championship, the Chinese players were still very happy. At least they were the runner-up, surpassing most of the other teams. The first season of the Pro League could be said to be a success, and many foreign viewers were even fans of the Chinese teams.

Compared to the rankings in his previous life, the results this time were much better. In his previous life, China only had one semi-finalist, but now, there were two Chinese teams in the top eight. Long Sky was in the top eight, and Dynasty was the runner-up. There was also improvement in the Singles competition. In his previous life, King Admiral was the only player in the top sixteen. Now, there was Mad Blade, who had won glory for the country and enjoyed a triumphant return.

The results were much better than in his previous life, and the only reason was because of Han Technician.

The players who followed him had good results, and his own influence would also increase subtly, expanding the potential market. Han Xiao was very satisfied with the performance of the players.

Dynasty was overjoyed with such results. Even Second Prince, who loved to talk big, had a happy face and did not scold his captain, which was rare. Long Sky's ranking was not bad, but it was not bad. However, Hao Tian was not satisfied. His attitude of working hard never stopped. Mad Blade was in the top sixteen of the Singles competition, and he was very satisfied. This was a result that he did not even dare to imagine in the past. Most of the Chinese players were satisfied with their own results, but Temple of God was a little jealous of Dynasty and Long Sky's results and praise. In comparison, Temple of God's performance in the first season was much dimmer.

After the Pro League ended, all sorts of follow-up programs took place. The various programs reported and commented on the Pro League, the various teams held press conferences, and the final award ceremony. However, these were not the focus of Han Xiao's attention. The end of the first season also meant …

The version update was coming!

The last version update was three years ago. To Blue Star, the sudden appearance of these players had caused a wave of panic, and the version update from Version 10 to Version 20 would cause these players to disappear again.

Usually, six days in the game was equivalent to one day in 'real life' for the players, and the flow of time was stable. However, during the version update, the time connection between the two sides would be broken. The Version 10 update would take one year in the game, but to the players, it would only take two to three days.

The time span of each version update was different. The players would enter Galaxy at different points in the timeline, and it was usually a major event or disaster that formed the version.

When the version update comes, these players will not be around. Without these useful cannon fodders, I will have to be more cautious. Furthermore, there will not be a way to quickly harvest experience and money in a year, so it's the best time to find those missions with potential. As for the specific actions, I will need to make a plan … Han Xiao fell into deep thought.
